title: Zoho halts 2026 salary hikes, looks to ‘avoid mass layoffs’ amid surging AI costs
llm_summary: Zoho has put a pause on salary increases for 2026 as it grapples with the steep expenses of scaling its AI initiatives. Rather than resorting to large‑scale layoffs, the company is tightening compensation to keep its workforce intact while it works out a sustainable cost structure for its new AI‑driven products.
